bugEvidence.before: An integration regression against the original PostgreSQL source failed because ReservedJob timestamp fields were strings instead of Date instances. The public date arithmetic contract was violated.
bugEvidence.fix: Normalize availableAt, reservedAt and createdAt using new Date at the raw-query row mapping boundary; accept Date|string in the internal driver row type.
bugEvidence.tests: Nineteen new memory cases, twenty new PostgreSQL cases, four actual exported-schema cases and both adapter factory cases, plus one multi-identity follow-up case. Existing PostgreSQL Date case also checks absent optional metadata does not leak SQL NULL.

comparison.policy: Match normalized original/operator/replacement/occurrence, not numeric IDs or line numbers. Whole bodies changed by a production fix are different variants; total-count score movement alone does not prove a same-corpus improvement.
